unmapped_concepts.fact:household.mortgage_interest: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input mortgage interest determines on its own: the only owner-cost input, accommodation_supplement_owner_weekly_required_payments (Family, social_security/accommodation_supplement/core.yaml, s 65AAA), is the owner's weekly 'required mortgage-security payments and reasonably required home payments', which needs interest and principal (and other home payments) summed and then scaled by 1/52, and no transform composes a sum with a scale; accommodation_supplement_concessionary_mortgage_payments_to_kainga_ora_or_crown (s 66) needs the lender's identity.
unmapped_concepts.fact:household.mortgage_principal: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input mortgage principal determines on its own: the only owner-cost input, accommodation_supplement_owner_weekly_required_payments (Family, social_security/accommodation_supplement/core.yaml, s 65AAA), needs principal and interest (and other home payments) summed and then scaled to a weekly amount, and no transform composes a sum with a scale.
unmapped_concepts.fact:household.property_tax: The only rates input, rr_rates_payable_before_rebate (Person) in statutes/rates_rebates/rates_rebate.yaml, cannot be bound at 6fe181f, because the dense engine could not compile that module and nz.json lists it only under cli_walk_inputs, which the adapter's surface loader does not read; once the module compiles, allocate_to_reference_person of property_tax is the candidate (approximate, because the ratepayer need not be the reference person).
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.educational_attainment: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input for completed education: no rule or input name mentions a qualification, degree, diploma or attainment level; the education inputs are current enrollment or school attendance (this mapping binds some of them to education_enrollment and enrolled_full_time); and young_person_is_study_ready is what youth_young_parent_payment/core.yaml calls an agency-adjudicated composite input (s 50).
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.private_pension_income: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input the concept determines: the pension inputs are Family-level family-scheme items defined by contribution source or exempt status rather than receipt (family_scheme_superannuation_distribution_income under MB 5 counts only distributions attributable to employer contributions; family_scheme_retirement_scheme_distribution_income is MB 6; family_scheme_exempt_pension_or_annuity_amount is MB 10's exempt pensions and annuities, half included), and community_services_card_raw_superannuation_income is the reg 8(5A) superannuitant income-test total.
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.realized_capital_gains: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input for gains on disposals: no rule mentions gains, disposals or the bright-line test, and the only capital input, income_tax_expenditure_or_loss_is_capital_nature (income_tax/core/taxable_income.yaml, s DA 2), classifies expenditure for the general deduction limitation.
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.rental_income: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input for rental or other property income: the only activity-income inputs (income_tax_activity_income in income_tax/core/taxable_income.yaml and family_scheme_activity_income in family_scheme_income.yaml) are the MB 3 bridge the module labels 'business and self-employment activity income' and are already bound to self-employment profit; accommodation_supplement_weekly_rent_received_from_other_residents is rent from co-residents of the own dwelling, which the concept excludes; and the benefit income-test inputs are weekly totals of all income.
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.sex: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no sex- or gender-dependent input: none of the 668 dense-surface input names or 40 module YAMLs mention sex, gender, male, female, man, woman, wife or husband, and the only related hit, sole_parent_is_mother_or_father_or_child_regarded_as_child (social_security/main_benefits/entitlement.yaml), tests parenthood, which this mapping binds to the parent_of_coresident_child role.
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.usual_weekly_hours: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input that takes hours worked: the work-hours inputs are threshold statuses no transform can compute from hours, namely acc_self_employed_more_than_30_hours_per_week (regulations/acc/earners_levy.yaml, reg 6, which also needs self-employment hours alone), jobseeker_in_full_time_employment (main_benefits/entitlement.yaml, s 21), acc_weekly_compensation_is_full_time_earner and the Family-level in_work_tax_credit_normally_full_time_earner; the remaining hours_per_week inputs are childcare, programme-participation or work-capacity hours.
unmapped_concepts.fact:person.weeks_worked: rulespec-nz at 6fe181f has no input the concept determines: the closest, in_work_tax_credit_weekly_periods (Family, income_tax/family_scheme/tax_credits.yaml, s MD 10(2)), counts weeks in which the person or their partner meets the earner requirement, which needs the union of two partners' work weeks that no group rule gives (reference_member drops a working partner; sum_over_members double-counts and adds children's weeks), and minimum_family_tax_credit_weekly_periods and minimum_family_full_time_earner_weeks count only weeks as a full-time earner.
